[ 6718.241452] Not tainted 4.4.178-16473-g2e7bd078f16a #1 [ 6718.241455] "echo 0 > /proc/sys/kernel/hung_task_timeout_secs" disables this message. arc: net: Rename guest interfaces associated with native VPNs Android VPNs and native Chrome OS VPNs both used tun interfaces with the usual "tun%d" name pattern. This creates a conflict when arc-networkd tries to expose a tun%d host interface into the ARC networking environment and tries to reuse the same name. Since the Android VPN interface name pattern cannot be changed, host VPN interfaces are exposed in the ARC networking environment with a a special prefix to let ARC distinguish between both kinds. init: Have udev-trigger-early wait for i2c-dev subsystem to settle. Also, udev-trigger-early is now marked as a task job, mirroring udev-trigger. This fixes a boot ordering issue where /dev/i2c-<N> permissions were not updated to allow i2c group access when the touch updaters run. BUG=b:79157488 TEST=With this change, the Atlas touchpad firmware updater works on boot. bootperf timings, with chromeos-etphidiap-touch-firmware-update.sh short-circuited to exit 0 before /dev/i2c-<N> permissions become involved: cr-c-1562459-baseline-run0 (on 10 cycles): time s% dt s% event 1076 8% +1076 8% startup 1953 5% +877 5% startup_done cr-c-1562459-patchset5-run0 (on 10 cycles): time s% dt s% event 1099 4% +1099 4% startup 2029 5% +930 7% startup_done cr-c-1562459-patchset6-run0 (on 10 cycles): time s% dt s% event 1113 3% +1113 3% startup 2024 4% +911 7% startup_done cr-c-1562459-patchset6-run1 (on 10 cycles): time s% dt s% event 1067 9% +1067 9% startup 2002 6% +935 6% startup_done I do not believe the other 4 events tracked by bootperf are relevant to this CL, and 3 of them appear highly variable in duration. My interpretation of these results is that any boot time difference from this CL is lost in the noise when measured at bootperf event granularity. Change-Id: Iba675cf585f2b330490ecf5dbf1d7b78a77e8d78 Signed-off-by: Matthew Blecker <matthewb@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1562459 Reviewed-by: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org>
